title: Video Editor — Personal Brand & App Marketing Content
description:
# Video Editor — Personal Brand & App Marketing Content



PARA//EL. Dating App | Remote | Part-Time | $400–600/month USD



## About the Role



I'm the founder of PARA//EL. (getparallel.vip) — a new compatibility-first dating app launching in the US. I create short-form video content for TikTok and Instagram Reels and need a skilled editor to help me produce polished, on-brand videos consistently.



This is a long-term part-time role. I'm looking for someone I can grow with as the app scales.



## What You'll Be Editing



- Talking head videos — me speaking to camera about dating, relationships, compatibility, and the app. These are the core content type.

- App explainer clips — screen recordings and UI mockup animations showing how the app works

- Hype/promo videos — fast-cut product reels for ads and launch content

- Repurposed content — cutting longer videos into shorter clips, reformatting for different platforms



Volume: 3–5 videos per week to start, growing over time.



## The Style I'm Going For



Watch these creators and match this energy:

- Word-by-word flashing captions (like Alex Hormozi / Bun Bun content style)

- Clean, fast-cut talking head edits — remove all filler words, long pauses, and "so" at the start of sentences

- Subtle zooms and punch-ins on key 
nts

- B-roll drops (app screenshots, text overlays, animations) timed to what I'm saying

- Dark, premium aesthetic — purple accent color (#7B5EA7), white text

- Background music at low volume (8–12%), auto-ducked under voice



Brand colors:

- Accent: Parallel Purple #7B5EA7

- Text: White #FFFFFF

- No pink, red, orange, yellow, or green — ever



Caption style:

- One word at a time, flashing

- White text on purple #7B5EA7 background pill

- Bold, large, centered or lower third



## Your Responsibilities



1. Receive raw video file + editing notes fro
 (via Google Drive or Dropbox)

2. Remove all filler words, long pauses, "um", "so", mid-sentence cuts

3. Reorder clips if the story flow needs it (I'll flag this)

4. Add word-by-word captions in brand style

5. Add B-roll, text overlays, and transitions as noted

6. Add background music (I'll provide or approve track)

7. Export in 9:16 vertical format for TikTok/Reels (1080x1920)

8. Deliver edited video within 48 hours of receiving raw footage

9. Revisions turned around within 24 hours



## Tools Required



- Descript (primary — I already have a project set up)

- CapCut or Adobe Premiere Pro for more complex edits

- Google Drive for file transfer



## What I'm Looking For



- Experience editing talking head / personal brand / lifestyle content (not wedding or corporate video)

- Strong eye for pacing — you know when to cut, when to let something breathe

- Detail-oriented with captions — no typos, correct timing, consistent style

- Reliable and communicates proactively if something will be late

- Comfortable working independently with clear written briefs



Bonus (not required):

- Experience with dating, relationship, or app-category content

- Familiarity with TikTok trends and sounds

- Basic motion graphics (text animations, lower thirds)



## Trial Project



Before hiring, I'll send you one raw video (approx. 3 minutes) with editing notes. Please edit it in my style and return within 48 hours. I'll review and if it's a great fit, we'll get started.



Trial pay: $25 USD for the trial edit.



## How to Apply



Please send:

1. 2–3 samples of talking head or personal brand content you've edited (YouTube, TikTok, or Drive links)

2. A one-paragraph note about your experience with short-form content

3. Your availability and typical turnaround time

4. Your monthly rate for 3–5 videos/week



Send applications to: 

Subject line: Video Editor Application — [Your Name]



PARA//EL. is a US-based startup. This is a remote, contract position. Payment via ACH bank transfer (Mercury).

title: Collections Caller Agent -
description:
About the Role



North Funding is a Canadian direct lender providing merchant cash advances to small and medium sized businesses across North America. We are looking for a professional and composed collections caller to join our team on a part time remote basis.

Your role is simple. Every business day you receive a list of merchants with missed or delinquent payments. You call them, you listen, you work with them to find a resolution, and you log everything accurately. You are not aggressive. You are not threatening. You are a professional who helps business owners get back on track while protecting the interests of the company.



What You Will Do



Receive the daily delinquent account report from our operations coordinator every morning by 9am Eastern time. The report includes merchant name, phone number, deal ID, outstanding balance, number of missed payments, and last contact date.

Call every merchant on the daily list. Attempt each merchant at least twice per day at different times if there is no answer on the first attempt. Leave a brief professional voi
 on the first attempt if the merchant does not pick up.

Work through the conversation calmly and professionally. Identify the reason for the missed payment, offer appropriate resolution options within your defined authority, and agree on a clear next step with the merchant before ending the call.

Log every call attempt in our CRM immediately after each call. Record whether the merchant was reached, what was discussed, and what outcome was agreed. Accurate and complete logging is a non negotiable requirement of this role.

Send our operations coordinator a daily end of day summary covering every account you called, the outcome of each call, and any payment arrangements that were agreed.

Flag the operations coordinator immediately if a merchant is unresponsive after multiple attempts, aggressive or threatening, or refusing all cooperation. You never escalate directly to management. All escalations go through the operations coordinator.



Payment Arrangement Authority



You have full authority to offer the following arrangements without any approval needed.

Reduced payment arrangement. You may offer to accept 50% of the merchant's daily payment amount for up to 10 consecutive business days while they stabilize their cash flow. Log the agreed start date and end date in the CRM immediately.

Short payment holiday. You may offer to pause payments entirely for up to 5 consecutive business days. This option can only be offered once per merchant per 6 month period. Log the agreed pause dates in the CRM immediately.

Any arrangement outside these parameters must be escalated to the operations coordinator. You never promise anything you do not have authority to deliver.



What You Never Do



Discuss legal action, court proceedings, or collections agencies with any merchant under any circumstances. Make promises about credit reporting or removing negative marks from any record. Accept payment by any method other than the merchant's existing pre-authorized debit arrangement or a direct wire to our company bank account. Contact merchants outside of Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm Eastern time. Argue, raise your voice, or engage with an aggressive merchant beyond one calm attempt to de-escalate.



What We Are Looking For



Based in the Philippines with reliable internet connection and availability during Eastern business hours. Strong conversational English with clear pronunciation. Calm, professional, and composed when dealing with stressed or difficult business owners. Previous experience in collections, debt recovery, customer service, or financial services outbound calling is required. Comfortable learning and using a CRM system for call logging. Detail oriented with strong written communication for daily reporting. Able to work independently with minimal supervision.

title: HubSpot CMS & UX/UI Web Developer
description:
HubSpot CMS & UX/UI Web Developer



Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time Contract

Work Schedule: Must be available to work during Pacific Standard Time business hours

Compensation: $8–$12 per hour USD, depending on experience and skill set



About Set 2 Close



Set 2 Close is a revenue operations and enablement agency that helps businesses optimize their marketing, sales, and customer success systems for predictable growth. We bridge the gap between strategy, technology, and execution by helping clients build better systems, improve workflows, and create scalable digital experiences.



We are looking for a HubSpot CMS & UX/UI Web Developer to join our team. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong front-end development skills with a sharp eye for user experience and visual design. The right candidate will be comfortable working directly with clients to design, build, and optimize web pages inside HubSpot CMS / Content Hub.



Role Overview

The HubSpot CMS & UX/UI Web Developer will be responsible for creating responsive, user-friendly, and visually polished web pages using HubSpot CMS. This person should be well-versed in HubSpot’s CMS capabilities, including website building, templates, modules, HubDB, integrations, and front-end customization.



This role is primarily focused on HubSpot CMS web design and development, but experience with HubSpot reporting, analytics, pipelines, marketing campaigns, and general HubSpot administration will be valuable.



We are looking for someone who can take client requirements, translate them into strong UX/UI designs, and then build functional, scalable web pages within HubSpot.



* Key Responsibilities

HubSpot CMS Web Design & Development

Design, build, and maintain responsive web pages using HubSpot CMS / Content Hub.

Develop and customize HubSpot templates, themes, modules, landing pages, and website pages.

Use HTML, CSS, HubL, and basic JavaScript to create clean, scalable, and functional front-end experiences.

Build modular page designs that are easy for clients and internal teams to update.

Work with HubDB to create dynamic content and database-driven web pages.

Support the setup and customization of HubSpot CMS assets, including forms, CTAs, menus, blog templates, and global content.

Ensure websites and landing pages are optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile experiences.



* UX/UI Design

Create clean, intuitive, and visually appealing user interfaces.

Translate client brand guidelines, marketing goals, and business requirements into strong web experiences.

Apply UX/UI best practices to improve usability, navigation, page flow, and conversion performance.

Design wireframes, mockups, or page layouts when needed before development.

Balance design aesthetics with practical, functional, and scalable implementation inside HubSpot.



* Client-Facing Collaboration

Work directly with clients to understand their website needs, page requirements, branding, and desired user experience.

Communicate technical and design decisions clearly to both clients and internal teams.

Collaborate with marketing strategists, RevOps specialists, developers, and project managers to deliver high-quality HubSpot CMS projects.

Gather feedback, make revisions, and ensure final web pages align with client expectations.



* HubSpot Marketing & CRM Support

Assist with building and supporting HubSpot marketing campaigns.

Help create and optimize landing pages, forms, workflows,
 assets, and campaign-related web pages.

Support basic HubSpot reporting and analytics setup.

Assist with HubSpot pipeline setup, basic CRM configuration, and marketing/sales process support when needed.

Use HubSpot reporting tools to help clients understand website performance, campaign results, and conversion activity.



* Testing, Optimization & Maintenance

Test pages across browsers, devices, and screen sizes.

Troubleshoot layout, styling, responsiveness, and CMS-related issues.

Optimize pages for speed, SEO, accessibility, and conversion best practices.

Maintain clean, organized, and reusable front-end code.

Identify opportunities to improve existing HubSpot CMS pages, templates, and user experiences.



* Required Skills & Qualifications

Proven experience designing and developing websites inside HubSpot CMS / Content Hub.

Strong front-end development skills, especially in HTML, CSS, and HubL.

Working knowledge of JavaScript is preferred.

Strong understanding of UX/UI design principles.

Experience building responsive websites and landing pages.

Experience working with HubSpot templates, modules, themes, and CMS page editing tools.

Familiarity with HubDB and dynamic content inside HubSpot.

Ability to build visually appealing designs and translate them into functional web pages.

Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with clients.

Ability to collaborate with marketing, sales, and technical teams.

Understanding of SEO, accessibility, website speed, and conversion best practices.

Ability to work during Pacific Standard Time business hours.

A portfolio showcasing HubSpot CMS, UX/UI, web design, or front-end development work is required.



* Nice-to-Have Skills

Experience with HubSpot Content Hub Remix.

Experience creating custom HubSpot themes and reusable modules.

Experience with HubSpot marketing tools,
 campaigns, workflows, forms, and CTAs.

Experience setting up HubSpot dashboards, reports, and basic analytics.

Experience building or supporting HubSpot pipelines.

Basic understanding of RevOps, CRM systems, lead generation, and marketing automation.

Experience using design tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, Canva, or similar platforms.

Experience working in an agency or client-facing environment.



* Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hybrid designer and developer who understands both how a website should look and how it should function. You are creative, detail-oriented, and technically capable. You can work with a client to understand their vision, design a strong user experience, and build it inside HubSpot CMS.

You should be comfortable taking ownership of HubSpot CMS projects, from page layout and UX/UI design to front-end implementation and troubleshooting. You enjoy creating web pages that are not only visually strong but also functional, responsive, and easy to manage.



This role is best suited for someone who can communicate clearly, work independently, collaborate with internal teams, and deliver high-quality HubSpot CMS experiences for clients.



* Compensation & Benefits

$8–$12 per hour USD, based on experience and skill set.

Remote work setup.

Opportunity to work with a fast-growing revenue operations and enablement agency.

Exposure to HubSpot CMS, RevOps, marketing automation, CRM, and client-facing digital projects.

Collaborative environment with opportunities to grow technical, creative, and strategic skills.

Resume

title: Content Operations Manager / Social Media Team Lead
description:
We are looking for a highly organised Content Operations Manager / Social Media Team Lead to manage a Reddit-based content operation.



Reddit experience is helpful, but it is not the main requirement. We are looking for someone who can manage people, organise data, make good decisions, understand content, and help improve the system over time.



This role is best for someone who is strategic, reliable, organised, and confident managing a team.



Responsibilities:



* Manage the day-to-day content posting operation

* Lead and communicate with the posting team

* Make sure daily tasks are completed correctly

* Build subreddit lists based on each brand, niche, content style, and audience

* Track post performance and organise data clearly

* Analyse what content is working and what is not working

* Make decisions based on results, not guesses

* Give feedback to the team on content, captions, subreddit choices, and performance



What we are looking for:



* Strong leadership skills

* Experience managing people, projects, or daily operations

* Good communication skills

* Strong organisation and data management skills

* Good decision-making ability

* Strategic thinking

* Good understanding of content and online attention

* Ability to understand branding

* Ability to spot patterns in what performs well

* Reliable, proactive, and able to take ownership



Reddit experience:



Previous Reddit experience is helpful, but not required. Training can be provided.



However, you must be able to understand:



* Why some content performs better than other content

* What makes content fit a specific audience

* How to match content to the right communities

* How to organise subreddit lists properly

* How to use data to improve results over time

title: YouTube Video Editor & Thumbnail Designer
description:

-Links to 2–3 YouTube channels or videos you've edited

-At least 2 thumbnail examples you've designed

-A brief note explaining what makes a good YouTube hook in your own words

title: Grant Writer (for music/entertainment nonprofit organization)
description:
Our organization is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit working upstream of the youth mental health crisis by turning fandom into a real protective force for young people. We meet teens and young adults in the music, artists, and fan communities they already love... and we deliver evidence-based mental health support in the cultural language they actually speak.



After nine years of building community trust inside fandoms (500K+ fans reached, partnerships with major artists and labels, a published book on the work), we're in a critical growth 
nt: launching our first fan-native toolkit, deepening retail and label partnerships (including Hot Topic, where we've already secured funding interest), and building toward becoming the infrastructure layer for upstream youth mental health.



We're looking for a grant writer to help fuel the next phase.



The Role

This is a performance-based grant writer role: you earn a percentage of every grant you successfully source and secure for our nonprofit organization. Note that there is no base salary by default but for the right candidate with the right experience, we can discuss a small monthly retainer in addition to the success fee as we're open to the structure that works for both sides.



You'll work closely with the Founder/CEO and our Project Manager to identify opportunities, write compelling proposals, and steward funder relationships. The work spans foundation grants, corporate philanthropy, corporate and brand sponsorships, and government funding sources at the intersection of youth mental health, music, arts, and community wellbeing.



What You'd Do

> Research and identify grant (or sponsorships) opportunities aligned with our organization's mission (foundation, corporate, and government)

> Write and submit grant proposals, letters of inquiry, and concept papers

> Maintain a grant pipeline tracker (what's been applied for, what's pending, what's been funded)

> Manage application deadlines and submission requirements

> Coordinate with the Founder on funder cultivation strategy

> Draft funder stewardship communications (thank-yous, progress reports, renewal asks)

> Build a growing library of grant materials (boilerplate, impact data, narratives) that can be reused across applications





What Success Looks Like (baseline) 

In the first 90 days, we anticipate that you have:

> Identified at least 15-20 well-matched grant opportunities for Superbands

> Submitted at least 5-8 strong applications

> Built a working grant pipeline tracker that becomes a permanent operational asset

> Begun a steady cadence of submissions and follow-ups

> Ideally secure at least 1-2 grants



Over the first year, you'll have secured meaningful funding that fuels our organization's next phase, and you'll have earned compensation tied directly to that success.



Note that should you be successful in the initial 90 day period, part time and/or full time employment opportunities may be provided so you can grow with our organization long term and continue to ensure our funding pipeline is blossoming. Our small team of 4 has been with us long term already and has grown with us... are YOU next? 



Compensation Structure

> Success fee: 10-12% of grants you successfully source and secure, paid when funds land in our org's account.

> Eligible grants: Any grant that you (a) identify and source, OR (b) write the bulk of the proposal for, where our org had not previously been in active conversation with the funder.

> Not eligible: Grants from the 2 funders already in our active pipeline at the time you start (list of funders provided at start), or grants secured primarily through the Founder's existing relationships.

Payment: Within 7-14 days of grant funds arriving in our NPO's account(s). Paid via Wise, PayPal, or direct deposit.

** Note - Retainer option (for the right candidate): If you have substantial grant-writing experience and prefer a hybrid structure, we're open to discussing a small monthly retainer in addition to a reduced success fee. Tell us what would work for you in your application.



Who You Are

> Experienced grant writer with a track record of secured funding (at any organizational stage — early-career to senior, we're open)

> Comfortable working independently and managing your own pipeline

> Strong writer who can translate complex mission work into compelling, fundable narratives

> Detail-oriented on application requirements, deadlines, and stewardship

Genuinely care about youth mental health, music/fandom culture, or upstream prevention *(this work won't feel right if you don't get the mission)

> Understand that performance-based compensation means real upside and real risk, and you're going into it with eyes open



Bonus if you have:

> Existing relationships in mental health, arts, music, or youth-focused funding

> Experience writing for both foundation and corporate philanthropy

> Familiarity with the protective factor / public health framing of mental health work

> Experience in pitching corporate sponsorships or partnerships 





What This Isn't - To save us both time:

> This is not a salaried staff role (unless we evolve into one together over time as the organization grows)

> This is not a fit if you need predictable monthly income from this role alone

> This is not a fit if you're looking to "make it big" off one or two grants. Currently our NPO is a real, growing nonprofit with a long runway of opportunity, but it's not a quick win

> We're not interested in writers who don't understand or believe in the mission. We'd rather work with the right person at lower volume than the wrong person at higher





How to Apply

Send the following in response to job posting for our team's review: 

> Your CV/resume or a summary of grant-writing experience, including notable secured funding (org names + amounts are great, but ranges are fine if confidentiality matters)

> A short note (1-2 paragraphs) on why this role and this mission resonates with you

> One writing sample, ideally a grant narrative, letter of inquiry, or proposal section you wrote



We read every application sent in this format and respond to everyone within two weeks.

title: Virtual Assistant To Join Successful Online Law Firm
description:
I'm looking to hire a virtual assistant with strong English fluency to join my team and work in my law firm for 32-35 hours/week. No prior legal experience necessary. Training is available. The work hours will probably be 10 AM to 5 PM CDT Mon-Fri.  You will get off at 1PM CDT on Friday. This allows you to get your weekend started earlier.  



You will need to answer the calls that come into my law office occasionally. You will need to make calls to the US through my phone system occasionally. You will have to talk to people to gather information from different court personnel and courthouses and/or check on the status of cases that you are working on from time to time. You will be using a VPN to access certain websites in the US. I will provide you the VPN to use. This is very important because some websites won't allow you access if you are accessing the website from a different country. 



You will need to have a quiet working environment because you will be interacting with clients and court personnel. Therefore, your workspace must be free of extraneous noise. Examples of noise would be family members talking in the background, babies crying, family members watching TV, Family members gaming online, dogs barking, etc. This requirement should be obvious since you will be talking on the phone to clients and professionals who work in the courts, etc.



Also you will need to keep track of client files and the status. This means you must be detail-oriented and have the ability to think logically. You will have to be well organized to keep track of the different stages that the clients' files are in and know how to use Google docs, Gmail, Google Meet,  Slack, Loom and the ability to learn some other applications. You must be a person who pays very close ATTENTION TO DETAIL because you will be editing legal documents and they must be accurate. The team will consist of you, me, and three other VA's.  I WOULD LIKE YOU TO CREATE A VIDEO THAT IS 1-2 MINUTES ON LOOM AND INTRODUCE YOURSELF AND LET ME KNOW WHY YOU WOULD BE A GOOD CANDIDATE FOR THIS POSITION WHEN YOU REPLY BACK TO THIS JOB POSTING.



We can discuss pay if you are chosen to be hired. You will have trial period of up to three months to see if you're going to work out with the team and if you are a good fit for my office.  I pay twice per month on the 1st of the month and the 15th of every month. There is a growth opportunity for you as my firm has grown from one (1) VA to three (3) VA's currently. I need to add a person to my team, and that's why I'm posting the ad.  I'm looking for someone to work permanently with me which means this a long term job and not a job that lasts for a few months or a couple of years.  I require honesty and loyalty, and I will reciprocate the same in return. You will need to work exclusively for me; otherwise, do not apply for this job. Also, if you are not detail-oriented, please don't apply. It's very important that you have strong organizational skills and very detail-oriented, and can read well.  English fluency is a must, and you must be able to write in English. You must have good internet connections, and I would prefer that you seldom have power outages.  



Please don't send me a prewritten generic
 that you send out to the masses because you're just applying for any job that is posted.  I'm looking for someone who wants to be apart of a team that is dedicated to the work that I have and is not working as a VA for someone else and me at the same time. As I stated you must be a detail-oriented person.  I'm going to delete any response that I receive that I believe is a generic
 not written specifically for this job posting.



Please send a proposal with why you want to work for me and why I should hire you over all other candidates that are applying for this position. Also, answer the following question: 2 + 2 = ? If you miss this simple question, it tells me that you are not detail-oriented enough and are not reading carefully, which is a huge requirement for this job. If I contact you, I will send you part 1 of some tasks that I will ask you to perform. If you pass the first task, I will send you another, and if you pass that, I will send you a third, and if you pass that task, I know that you are capable of doing this job, and then we can move to a face-to-face interview that we will do online on Google Meet. 



I go through this process because it will reveal to me if you are the right candidate for this job, and I don't waste time, and you don't waste time if you're not well suited for this position. This position requires skills beyond working in a call center, sending out
s for employers, making posts to social media accounts, or booking trips for your employer. It is a very challenging job and requires you to be able to think critically and logically and read and be able to discern details in documents that you probably are not used to doing in some of your previous jobs.



Thank you for your time and consideration.
salary: $300 for part time and $600 for fulltime

title: Automations Specialist
description:
Let’s be clear. This isn’t a “follow-the-steps” kind of role.



At DAP Brands, we build systems that scale. We move fast, automate aggressively, and continuously optimize how work gets done across Sales, Marketing, and Operations.



We’re looking for a detail-oriented, technically capable, and solution-driven Integrations Associate who doesn’t just execute tasks but understands how systems connect, why they break, and how to make them better.



If you think in workflows, enjoy solving inefficiencies, and know how to turn manual processes into clean, automated systems...keep reading.



What You’ll Do



Build & Maintain Integrations

Set up, test, launch, and maintain automations using tools like Zapier, Make, and GoHighLevel. Monitor performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement long-term fixes—not band-aid solutions.



Optimize Workflows

Identify gaps in current processes and design smarter, more efficient systems. Work cross-functionally to understand needs and translate them into scalable automations.



Handle Technical Problem-Solving

Work with APIs, webhooks, and basic scripting (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL) to resolve sync issues, errors, and performance bottlenecks.



Document & Enable Teams

Create clear documentation for workflows and systems. Support internal teams by helping them understand and effectively use new automations.



Tools You’ll Work With:

1. Automation & Integrations: Zapier, Make, Webhooks

2. CRMs & Operations: GoHighLevel, Stripe, ClickUp

3. Collaboration: Google Sheets, Zoom, Google Workspace

4. Technical Stack: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL, APIs



Who This Role Is For



You’ll thrive here if you:

1. Take ownership and don’t wait to be told what to fix

2. Think in systems, not just tasks

3. Enjoy solving problems at the root, not the surface

4. Are comfortable in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment

5. Care about building processes that actually scale



Apply here: 



Important:

To be considered, type “MAVERICK” in front of your full name when submitting your application.

title: Google SEO, Website & Digital Growth Specialist
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are looking for someone who can help increase our visibility on Google, improve our website performance, increase inbound inquiries, improve local search rankings, and help generate more catering and private chef bookings.

• Weekly ranking reports • Keyword tracking reports • Website update logs • SEO reports • Google Business Profile reports • Traffic reports • Conversion reports

Our goal is simple: increase visibility, increase bookings, increase inbound inquiries, grow our social media presence, improve our systems, expand our brand, launch additional products and services, and continue building Mick's Kitchen & Catering into a premier catering and private chef company.

title: Project Manager & Writer
description:
JOB OVERVIEW 

Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours/week 

Hours: Fixed schedule — 8:00 AM–4:00 PM PST or 9:00 AM–5:00 PM PST, Monday–Friday 

Location: Remote (PST hours required) 



Overview 

American Standard Adhesives (ASA), a US-based distributor of hot melt adhesive solutions for B2B industries is looking for a self-starter Project Manager & Writer to execute the marketing initiatives laid out by our Marketing Manager. You will take full ownership of each project from kickoff through completion — driving the work forward independently between milestones and deliverables that the Marketing Manager will check at each step. We've been in the adhesives business for over 20 years. Only candidates with strong English communication (written/spoken) will be considered. 





Responsibilities 





Project Management (~45%) 



Own the end-to-end marketing lifecycle for new products — writing product listings, coordinating packaging design, confirming selling price with finance, and driving through to live launch 



Conduct competitor research on third-party websites and listings — identify what's working, what isn't, and surface recommendations (or execute against direction from the Marketing Manager) 



Coordinate external designers, freelancers, and internal contributors through project management tools 



Lead website content development and refresh cycles end-to-end, partnering with technical staff for chemistry/materials accuracy 



Manage ongoing packaging and collateral design projects (e.g., box labels, user manuals) 





Writing & Content (~45%) 



Own third-party platform product listings — product titles, listing copy, A+ content modules, and mobile-optimized variants 



Develop sales and marketing presentations — capabilities decks, launch slides, and customer-facing collateral 



Own the research, writing, and audience framing for technical content (product articles, application guides, technical sheets) — R&D/chemistry staff own subject-matter accuracy; this role owns translating it into clear, audience-appropriate copy 



Research the target audience for each piece — buyer persona, technical depth, channel — and calibrate tone, positioning, and structure accordingly 



Author and maintain internal documentation and SOPs 





Ad Hoc Operations Support (~10%) 



Provides general administrative and operational support as needed. 





Qualifications 



Minimum 8 years of hands-on experience in project management, content writing, and/or digital marketing — we are not training a beginner from scratch 



Strong written and verbal English — clear, professional, and to the point 



Self-starter who executes against a brief and drives it to finished deliverable without hand-holding between milestones 



Comfortable conducting competitor and market research; able to surface insights or execute against a clear research brief 



Highly organized across parallel workstreams; catches errors before they go live 



Experience coordinating with designers, freelancers, or creative teams 



Familiarity with e-commerce platforms, product listing tools, or B2B marketplaces 



Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 



Experience in industrial products, adhesives, or B2B e-commerce is a plus 



Solid understanding of SEO for product listings 





Schedule Requirements 



Full-time, Monday–Friday 



Must work either 8:00 AM–4:00 PM PST or 9:00 AM–5:00 PM PST 



No flexi-time or alternative schedules 



Must be fully available during PST business hours 



Reports to: Marketing Manager 





Please attach your resume.

title: Senior Operations Support Coordinator — High-Ownership Role (Remote, PST Hours, Long-Term)
description:
Senior Operations Support Coordinator - High-Ownership Role (Remote, PST Hours, Long-Term)



American Standard Adhesives, Inc. 



Remote  |  Full-Time  |  Fixed PST Hours 



Reports To: Owner 



Works Closely With: Customer Service & Order Processing Specialist 



Department: Operations 



Status: Full-Time 



Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:00 PM PST or 9:00 AM–5:00 PM PST 



Location: Remote (PST hours required) 



 



About the Company 



American Standard Adhesives, Inc. (ASA) is a U.S.-based manufacturer and distributor of industrial adhesive products, serving a diverse base of customers across multiple industries. Our lean team plays a critical role in keeping our day-to-day operations running smoothly and our customers well-served. 



1. Position Summary 



This is not an entry-level VA role. We are hiring a senior operator who can own recurring workflow, coordinate across teams, and escalate well. If you are looking for light remote work or a side gig, please do not apply.



The Operations Support Coordinator is a senior supportive role that helps the Owner run the day-to-day operational workflow of American Standard Adhesives. This person owns the repetitive, structured, and recurring tasks across the operation, and serves as a coordination point between back office, warehouse, accounting, and sales support functions. 



This is a support role, not a decision-making role. The Owner retains all final decision-making authority over pricing, commitments, disputes, personnel, and policy. The Operations Support Coordinator is empowered to execute within established SOPs and Work Instructions, to coordinate across teams, and to escalate exceptions promptly. 



The Operations Support Coordinator works side-by-side with the Customer Service & Order Processing Specialist, who manages the day-to-day order workflow. This role requires a working understanding of the order processing function so that coverage, overflow, and escalation handling are seamless. 



2. Key Responsibilities 



A. Order & Back Office Coordination — ~30% 



Support the Customer Service & Order Processing Specialist with order flow, including purchase order handling, invoicing, and customer acknowledgments. 



Monitor the open order queue daily; flag bottlenecks and aging orders to the Owner. 



Coordinate between back office and warehouse on daily outbound orders. 



Maintain visibility across online and third-party platforms, as well as direct customer order channels. 



Provide coverage for the Customer Service & Order Processing Specialist during absences or peak volume. 



B. Shipping & Warehouse Coordination — ~20% 



Coordinate shipping label creation and communicate with the warehouse on daily picking and shipping. 



Coordinate parcel and pallet shipments across all channels. 



Liaise with the warehouse team on picking and shipping. 



Ensure shipping documentation is accurate and filed. 



Confirm end-of-day shipment closure with the warehouse through direct communication. 



C. Import & Vendor Coordination — ~15% 



Support recurring import workflows, including container tracking and customs follow-up. 



Manage the vendor
 channel: monitoring, routing, and filing per company work instructions. 



Maintain vendor files and supporting documentation. 



Draft vendor communications for Owner review when commitments are involved. 



D. Compliance, Insurance & Risk — ~10% 



Coordinate contractor file tracking, insurance certificate collection, and renewal calendars. 



Support tenant verification and related compliance workflows where applicable. 



Keep compliance records organized per company file-naming guidelines. 



E. Recurring Administrative & Systems Tasks — ~15% 



File and folder organization across company systems, per internal guidelines. 



Accounting system data entry support (bookkeeping execution only — not financial decisions). 



Pull and format operational and margin reports for Owner review. 



Maintain quality assurance and product documentation. 



Support system administration tasks under Owner direction. 



F. Project-Based & Ad Hoc Support — ~10% 



Support insurance renewals, hiring and recruitment coordination, and SOP documentation. 



Prepare case or claim files for Owner review. 



Handle time-sensitive special tasks requiring independent follow-up within pre-approved scope. 



3. Authority & Decision Boundaries 



This is an execution and coordination role, not a decision-making role. Clarity here protects the business and the person in the role. 



The Operations Support Coordinator MAY: 



Execute any task covered by an existing Work Instruction or SOP. 



Coordinate teammates, vendors, and carriers within pre-approved scope. 



Draft communications, quotations, and documents for Owner review. 



Flag exceptions, risks, and decision points upward promptly and in writing. 



Provide data, summaries, and recommendations to help the Owner d
 faster. 



The Operations Support Coordinator MAY NOT (without Owner approval): 



Approve pricing, discounts, credit terms, or payment terms. 



Commit the company to vendor contracts, service agreements, or long-term arrangements. 



Approve refunds, returns outside written policy, or customer concessions. 



Approve hiring, terminations, promotions, or compensation changes. 



Change SOPs, policies, or approve new processes without written Owner sign-off. 



Resolve disputes involving material money, legal exposure, or customer retention. 



When in doubt, escalate. Speed and clarity of escalation is valued over independent judgment on gray-area items. 



4. Qualifications 



Required 



Minimum 3 years of full-time professional experience in a corporate or BPO environment (operations, logistics, customer service, or back office support). 5+ years strongly preferred. Freelance, VA marketplace, or solo remote work alone does not qualify. 



Working knowledge of general accounting software, shipping software, Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, Outlook, Excel), and business phone systems. 



Strong English communication — written and spoken — with a clear, concise, professional tone. 



Proven ability to follow SOPs and Work Instructions precisely. 



Excellent organization; able to work within existing file naming and folder structures without disturbing them. 



Disciplined on escalation: knows what to d
, what to ask, and what to document. 



Ability to handle a mix of repetitive and non-repetitive tasks with minimal supervision. 



Preferred 



Import/export or logistics coordination exposure. 



Industrial supply, distribution, or manufacturing background. 



Experience supporting an owner-operated small or mid-size business. 



Analytical or accounting background. 



5. What We’re Looking For 



Highly organized with strong attention to detail. 



Proactive communicator who flags issues early rather than letting them escalate.

title: GoHighLevel Appointment Setter / Caller Coordinator — High-Ticket Coaching (UK Hours)
description:
**Job description:**



We train aspiring care entrepreneurs to launch CQC-registered care agencies in the UK. Every prospect books a call with our founder. Your job is to reach them BEFORE that call — get them ready, confirm they're serious, and keep the calendar full of real buyers, not no-shows.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:

- Reach every prospect who's booked a call — text first, then a quick prep call before their session.

- Gather the details the founder needs to make the call land, and confirm the prospect is real and committed.

- Give a friendly off-ramp (reschedule or cancel) to anyone clearly not ready, so the calendar stays full of genuine buyers.

- Kill no-shows: confirmations, reminders, day-of touchpoints, fast rescheduling.

- Manage the sales calendar across GoHighLevel and Outlook — clean, accurate, always moving.

- Keep the CRM accurate — every lead tagged and tracked.



WHAT "QUALIFIED" MEANS:

A prospect is a fit when all three are true — actively launching/setting up a CQC-registered care agency in the UK, has capital set aside (or a clear route to it), and can make the decision themselves. Not a fit: wants to work as a carer rather than run an agency, no money and no plan, just browsing with no timeline, or not launching in the UK.



REQUIREMENTS (must-haves):

- GoHighLevel proficiency — calendars, pipelines, workflows, tags. NON-NEGOTIABLE. If you haven't worked hands-on inside GHL, please don't apply.

- Solid Outlook calendar management.

- Strong phone presence — warm, builds rapport fast, people trust you.

- A genuine people person who's also relentlessly organised. Nothing slips.

- Fluent, confident English (written and spoken).



NICE TO HAVE:

- Setter or sales-support experience in high-ticket, coaching, or info-product.





HOUSE RULE:

You never discuss price or programme cost. That sits with the founder, handled on the call — you won't need it to do your job.



SCHEDULE: Full-time · Remote · UK working hours.

You've run TikTok for a real brand — not just your personal account, not just a side project. You've posted content, watched the numbers, formed a hypothesis, changed the approach, and done it again. You don't need someone to explain the algorithm to you. You need someone to let you work.

If that's you, keep reading. If you're still figuring out TikTok while managing it for brands, this isn't the right fit.

 

What You'll Own

• TikTok is your primary responsibility. You'll plan, script, edit, post, and iterate on content for 3 DTC product brands in the US natural goods space — bar soap, tallow skincare, and freeze-dried pet treats. Footage comes from the brand owner and UGC creators; your job is to make it perform. Expect 2–4 posts per week per active brand, scaling as the brands grow.

• Build and maintain a content calendar — and actually hit it, without being reminded.

• Write hooks that compete. Every video starts with a line or a visual that earns the next three seconds. You'll be judged on this.

• Select audio strategically — trending sounds, original audio, voiceover decisions. You'll know why you chose what you chose.

• Structure videos for completion rate: pacing, editing rhythm, CTA placement. CapCut or similar is your tool.

• Repurpose UGC and existing video assets into original-feeling content — recut, reframed, re-scored. You know how to transform raw footage so the algorithm treats it as new, not duplicate. Uncut re-uploads are not an option here.

• Use native TikTok formats — Duet, Stitch, Green Screen — strategically to extend reach, respond to trends, and generate engagement without starting from zero every time.

• Repurpose top-performing TikToks for Instagram Reels. Manage
 pages (posting, community replies, basic scheduling).

• Monitor comments and DMs across platforms; flag anything that needs owner attention.

• Coordinate with TikTok Shop: product link setup, affiliate outreach awareness, live selling scheduling when applicable.

• Track your own metrics — reach, watch time, saves, shares, follower growth — and deliver a clear weekly summary. No vanity-metric spin. Just honest numbers and what you're doing about them.

• Proactively bring content ideas, trend observations, and competitive intel to the owner. Don't wait to be asked.

 

What We're Looking For

Hard Requirements

• Minimum 2 years managing TikTok for a US-market brand or agency client (product brands preferred)

• Demonstrated results: you can show before/after data or real account growth you drove

• Fluent written English — you'll write scripts, captions, and direct communications with the brand owner

• Proficient in CapCut or equivalent mobile/desktop editing tool

• Available for async communication; able to flag urgent items in real time during PH business hours

• Reliable and deadline-driven — you treat posting schedules like commitments, not suggestions

• Comfortable working with minimal supervision on a fully remote team

Strong Advantages

• TikTok Shop experience: product linking, affiliate program coordination, LIVE commerce awareness

• Experience in natural products, wellness, pet, or handcrafted goods categories

• Proficiency with native TikTok formats: Duet, Stitch, Green Screen — used as deliberate reach and engagement tools, not just features

• Instagram Reels native editing (not just cross-posting)

• Familiarity with US consumer behavior and the DTC e-commerce landscape

 

?? TikTok Compliance & Platform Intelligence — Non-Negotiable

This section matters more than most postings acknowledge, so it gets its own block.

These brands operate in regulated-adjacent categories: skincare, pet nutrition, personal care. One compliant-looking post with the wrong claim, a banned audio track, or a policy violation the owner didn't know about can cost a suppressed account, a restricted shop, or worse.

We need someone who treats TikTok's Terms of Service, Community Guidelines, and Commerce Policies as required reading — not fine print.

That means:

• You track policy updates. You know what changed in the last 90 days and what it means for product-based content.

• You flag risks before posting — not after the fact.

• You understand what can and cannot be said in TikTok Shop product listings, video captions, and on-screen text for health and wellness products.

• You know which claim types trigger review, suppression, or removal, and you keep the brand far away from those lines.

• You understand TikTok's duplicate content detection — and know how to properly re-edit, reframe, and re-score UGC or existing footage so it registers as original. Re-uploading uncut videos is a fast way to get suppressed. You don't do that.

• You can explain your compliance reasoning when asked.

Candidates who treat this as a checkbox will not advance. Candidates who treat this as a professional discipline will.

 

What You'll Get

• $350–$550 USD/month, part-time (~20 hours/week) — based on experience and demonstrated results. This is a part-time engagement to start, with a clear path to full-time as the brands scale.

• Fully remote. Core hours are Manila time, founders live in Philippines. No micromanagement. No daily check-in calls. You own your schedule as long as deadlines are met.

• Stable, long-term engagement — this is not a project hire. The right person grows with us. As posting volume increases and results compound, the scope (and pay) expands.

• Clear scope. You won't be asked to do customer service, inventory, or tasks outside your lane.

• Direct access to the brand owner — decisions get made fast, feedback is real, and good work gets recognized.

 

How to Apply

Send the following:

1. A brief intro (3–5 sentences): who you are, what brands or accounts you've managed on TikTok, and one result you're proud of.

2. Links to 2–3 TikTok accounts you've managed (or specific videos if the accounts are no longer live). If the work is under NDA, describe it — but be specific.

3. Your answer to this question. This is required. No answer = no consideration:

"Name one TikTok rule, policy change, or platform update from the last 6 months that could affect a US e-commerce brand selling physical products. How would you handle it — both in terms of your content approach and what you'd communicate to the brand owner?"

Answer in your own words. A vague, generic or AI-generated response tells us everything we need to know.

 

These are small, real brands built around products people genuinely love. We're not filling a seat — we're looking for someone who takes pride in their work, wants a stable long-term role, and is ready to grow alongside us. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Mortgage Loan Processor
description:
Job Title: Mortgage Loan Processor (DSCR / Non-QM Focus)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Company: NEXA Mortgage, LLC







Position Overview



We are seeking a detail-oriented Mortgage Loan Processor with strong DSCR and investment property experience to support a high-volume pipeline. This role works directly with the Loan Originator to move files from submission to clear to close. The majority of your pipeline will be DSCR loans on investment properties, with a smaller mix of full doc conventional loans on primary residences and bank statement loans. The ideal candidate understands how each of these products is underwritten and can keep files moving without constant oversight.







Loan Types You Will Process



The bulk of this role is DSCR. You should be confident processing all three of the following:

DSCR / investment property loans (primary focus, majority of pipeline). Comfortable with rent schedules and DSCR ratio calculations, lease agreements and market rent (1007), business purpose and occupancy affidavits, entity vesting (LLC docs, operating agreements), and the non-QM condition set that comes with these files.

Conventional full doc loans on primary residences (smaller volume). Comfortable with income and asset documentation, AUS findings, and processing in full compliance with TRID timing and disclosure requirements.

Bank statement loans. Comfortable building and documenting income from personal or business bank statements and working with the lender's bank statement analysis requirements.







Key Responsibilities



Review new DSCR and Non-QM files for completeness and accuracy before submission. Submit files to underwriting and manage each loan through to clear to close. Review conditional approvals and prepare a clear, organized list of conditions. Communicate directly with borrowers to request and collect documentation, and explain underwriting conditions in plain, professional language. Follow up persistently with borrowers, third parties, and vendors to clear outstanding items. Order and track appraisals, title, insurance, and payoffs, and coordinate with those providers throughout the file. Calculate and verify DSCR ratios and confirm the file supports the program and pricing tier. Ensure TRID timing and disclosure requirements are met on every applicable file. Upload and organize all documentation in the LOS and keep compliance requirements satisfied. Work side by side with the Loan Originator to resolve conditions quickly and keep every file moving toward closing.







Qualifications



Prior experience as a Mortgage Loan Processor, with hands-on DSCR and Non-QM processing strongly preferred. Working knowledge of DSCR ratio calculations, rent schedules, and entity-vested investment property files. Experience processing conventional full doc loans under TRID, plus bank statement income loans. Familiarity with wholesale lender portals and submission processes. Strong written and verbal communication and the ability to work directly with borrowers. Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage many files at once. Comfortable in an LOS and document management platforms (LendingPad experience a plus).







Key Traits for Success



Confident processing DSCR files independently from submission to clear to close. Strong follow-up and file management under deadline pressure. Clear, professional communication with borrowers, lenders, and third parties. Detail-oriented, proactive, and able to spot a problem in a file before it becomes a delay.

title: UX/UI Web Designer
description:
*Web Designer (UX/UI) — Gig / Part-time / Full-time*

Boutique Branding Studio — Netherlands



---



*About the Role*



We're a boutique branding studio based in the Netherlands. We work at the intersection of brand strategy, identity, and digital execution. The websites we build are not afterthoughts to a brand project, they are the brand, made interactive.



We're looking for a Web Designer who leads with structure and ends with craft. Someone who opens a new project by thinking about pages, flows, and systems, not colours and typefaces. The visual execution matters enormously, but it comes last.



You'll join a small team on a gig basis, with a clear path to part-time and full-time for the right person. You'll own the design process from sitemap to hand-off, working alongside our brand leads and Webflow developer.



---



*Who You Are*



Before you are a designer, you are a systems thinker. You map information before you design screens. You wireframe to solve problems, not to sketch rough ideas. When you look at a website brief, your first instinct is to ask: what does this site need to do, how should it be structured, and how will someone move through it?



You understand the web as a medium, not a canvas. You think about scroll behaviour, states, responsiveness, and hierarchy the way a developer thinks about logic: it either works or it doesn't.



You're not a graphic designer who builds websites on the side. Web design is your specialism. It's where your thinking lives.



---



*What You'll Do*



— Translate briefs and brand strategy into sitemaps and content architecture before a single screen is designed

— Build wireframes that define structure, hierarchy, and user flow with enough detail that they could be critiqued and approved on their own

— Design full website concepts in Figma, desktop and mobile, using consistent components and a system-first approach

— Build and maintain design systems and component libraries that scale across pages and projects

— Hand off clean, structured Figma files to our Webflow developer with zero ambiguity

— Work closely with brand leads from briefing through to final design, contributing to conceptual direction where needed



---



*What We're Not Looking For*



A graphic designer who can also do web. Someone who jumps to visual design before the structure is solved. Someone who designs pages in isolation without thinking about the system they belong to. Someone who needs direction at every step.



If your portfolio is full of beautiful screens with no evidence of the thinking behind them, this is not the right role.



---



*What We're Looking For*



Required:

— 5+ years specialising in web design — not general graphic, brand, or print design

— A genuine process: sitemap ? wireframe ? visual design, every time

— Strong information architecture skills — you can define page structure, navigation logic, and content hierarchy from a brief

— Wireframes that stand on their own — detailed, annotated, and used as a real tool for alignment

— Expert Figma skills: components, auto layout, variants, design systems, developer hand-off

— A systems mindset — you think in reusable parts, not one-off pages

— Deep understanding of web UX: conversion logic, scroll behaviour, mobile-first thinking, interactive states

— Portfolio of live marketing and corporate websites that show process, not just output

— Clear, proactive communicator in English



Nice to have:

— Familiarity with Webflow, knowing how your designs will be built makes you a better designer

— Experience building or maintaining full design systems across multiple projects

— Conceptual contribution to brand and campaign work that feeds into web

— Micro-interaction or animation thinking at the wireframe stage



---



*How We Work Together*



A project starts with a briefing — sometimes strategic, sometimes a brand deep-dive, often both. From there, you lead: sitemap first, wireframes second, visual design third. You'll work closely with our brand leads and Webflow developer at each stage. Client communication stays with the studio. Your job is to design something that works and looks considered, then hand it off clearly.



We're a small team. We don't micromanage, and we don't chase. We expect you to ask the right questions early, raise blockers when they appear, and deliver work that doesn't need explaining.



---



*Compensation*



Hourly rate is based on experience and portfolio. We pay well for the right person.



This starts as a gig engagement. Strong collaborators will have the opportunity to move into a structured part-time role, and eventually a full-time position as the relationship grows.



---



*How to Apply*



Send us:



— Your portfolio — live websites only. We're not interested in Dribbble shots, unsolicited redesigns, or graphic design work. Show us websites you shipped.

— 2–3 case studies that walk us through your process: how you structured the site, what the wireframes looked like, how the final design connects back to the brief. The thinking matters as much as the output.

— A short introduction: who you are, what kinds of projects you've worked on, and your hourly rate.



*Applications without a process-driven case study will not be reviewed.*

title: Amazon, B&Q Mirakl account Manager with PPC experience
description:
We are a UK-based e-commerce business managing multiple private-label brands across Amazon and other major marketplaces. We are growing fast and expanding our presence on B&Q — one of the UK’s largest retail marketplaces.



We already have a strong Amazon operation. Now we need someone who knows exactly how Amazon works — and can take that knowledge and apply it to owning our B&Q marketplace account from the ground up.



What you will be doing



This role is 100% focused on B&Q. Your Amazon knowledge is the foundation — B&Q is the job.



Think of B&Q as a simpler version of Amazon. The logic is the same — listings, account health, order management, and paid advertising — but the platform is leaner and less complex. If you have owned an Amazon account and run PPC campaigns there, you will pick up B&Q quickly. That is exactly the profile we are hiring for.



B&Q runs on the Mirakl platform. You will be trained on its specifics, but your Amazon instincts are what will make you effective from day one.



Listings and account health



-Taking full ownership of our B&Q marketplace account

-Applying Amazon-grade listing standards to B&Q — titles, attributes, categorisation, images, content quality, and keyword logic translated into Mirakl’s framework

-Catching and resolving platform issues fast — listing rejections, content errors, order anomalies, platform notifications — the same discipline you would bring to a suppressed ASIN or account health warning on Amazon

-Building and maintaining clean, complete, high-performing listings across our full product catalogue



PPC — paid advertising on B&Q



-Managing paid advertising campaigns on the B&Q platform — the mechanics are simpler than Amazon PPC, but the same strategic thinking applies

-Keyword targeting, bid management, and performance monitoring to drive visibility and sales

-Tracking advertising spend against revenue and optimising toward a clear TACoS or cost-of-sale target

-This is a core part of the role, not an optional extra



What we expect from you



-You treat the B&Q account like it is your own business — you do not wait to be told what to check

-You bring Amazon discipline to a new platform: structured, data-driven, proactive

-You understand PPC at a strategic level — you know why a campaign is or is not working, not just how to change a bid

-If you are serious about this role, start your cover letter with the words — diversification is a way to go.

-You communicate clearly in writing and flag problems early, not after they cost money

-You work full-time, 40 hours per week, and you log your time in Clockify



Requirements



-Solid hands-on Amazon Seller Central experience — real account ownership, not agency dashboard watching

-Proven PPC experience on Amazon — Sponsored Products at minimum, Sponsored Brands a plus — with real TACoS or ACoS results you can speak to

-Comfort with learning new marketplace back-ends — Mirakl experience is a plus but not required if your Amazon foundations are strong

-Tools you must know: Amazon Seller Central, Asana, Google Sheets — state clearly in your application which of these you have used and at what level

-Familiarity with Helium 10 or a comparable keyword and analytics tool



What success looks like in this role

-Clearly state do you have experience with Mirakl platform

-B&Q account health is green and stays green

-Listings are complete, accurate, and optimised — no content errors, no rejected listings sitting unresolved

-SLAs are met consistently — zero avoidable late or cancelled orders

-Advertising spend is tracked, optimised, and moving toward TACoS targets month over month

-Weekly B&Q performance report lands every Monday without being chased

-Problems reach the Catalog Manager before they become expensive

title: Collections Coordinator + Accountant
description:
Collections Coordinator + Accountant



Remote 

Philippines

Full-time

US Eastern hours (9am-6pm EST) 

$1,650/mo base + commission



ABOUT SNAP DENTAL LABS

Snap Dental Labs is a US-based dental laboratory making high-end crowns, bridges, and implant

restorations for private dental practices across the United States. Our team is remote-first and fast?moving.



ABOUT THE ROLE

This is not a data-entry billing job. We are looking for someone who looks at a list of overdue accounts on

Monday morning, picks up the phone, and gets the money in ? without being asked. If that sounds like

you, keep reading. If that sounds uncomfortable, this role is not the right fit.



The two things that matter most, in order:

-Collections ownership. You will actively recover outstanding balances through calls and
s. You

handle everything that needs a human touch.

-Accounting and invoicing accuracy. You own the full weekly and monthly billing cycle ? invoice

generation, payment application, bank recs, AR aging review, and a clean monthly P&L draft.



There is no billing manager above you. You own this function.



WHAT YOU OWN



Daily

-Monitor the billing inbox and resolve clinic questions independently ? price disputes, invoice

corrections, payment status.

-Generate invoices in our system for completed dental cases.

-Apply incoming payments (ACH, credit card, check) to the correct invoices.

-Send payment links and payment-method forms to clinics with declined or missing payment methods.

-Follow up on any account that hasn't responded ? by phone if
 hasn't worked.



Weekly

-AR aging review call and
 any account 30+ days outstanding with a professional, firm

cadence.

-Reconcile incoming payments.

-Send a brief weekly summary: invoiced, collected, AR over 30 days, accounts at risk.



Monthly

-Run the full monthly invoice cycle independently.

-Bank and credit card reconciliation.

-Categorize all expenses against the chart of accounts.

-Produce a draft P&L and balance sheet for accounting partner review.

-Management summary: revenue, COGS, gross margin, AR aging, and notable collections risks.



COMPENSATION

-Base pay is $1,650 USD/month. On top of that, you earn commission on every balance you actively

recover, the older and harder the account, the higher your rate. Strong performers regularly hit

$2,500-$3,000/month total. There is no cap on commission.



REQUIREMENTS

-3+ years of accounts receivable, billing, and bookkeeping for US-based clients. This is a hard

requirement.

-Direct collections experience. You have called clients about overdue invoices. You can be firm and

professional without being aggressive. You can handle pushback without escalating to your manager.

-Accounting software. advanced. Full-charge monthly close: bank rec, journal entries, AR/AP, P&L

without supervision.

-Excellent written English. You will be writing directly to US dental practice managers and dentists

every day.

-US Eastern hours (9am-6pm EST). Non-negotiable.

-Reliable home setup. quiet workspace, backup power and internet, working webcam.

-Discretion. You will see clinic revenue and our full P&L.



NICE TO HAVE

-Experience with US dental or medical billing

-Familiarity with ACH processors or merchant account reconciliation

-US tax-prep season bookkeeping (1099s, year-end close)



HOW TO APPLY

 with the subject line "Collections Coordinator - [Your

Name]":

-Your resume

-A short loom video (5-8 sentences) describing your collections experience and one billing problem you

solved that you're proud of

-Your monthly salary expectation and earliest available start date

s using each client's existing brand assets and design systems

title: Creative Director, Social Media
description:
Who We Are

LEKKER Studios is a luxury real estate media company serving the NYC metro area. We work with builders, architects, brokers, and developers who compete at the top of the market. Our photography, video, and content do not look like anyone else's. That is not an a
. It is a discipline.

We are not a volume shop. We do not post for the algorithm. We build brands.



The Role

We are looking for a Creative Director who owns social media the way a brand manager owns a product line. You will manage content for LEKKER Studios and for a portfolio of our clients across Instagram, TikTok,
, and LinkedIn.

You understand that a grid is not a gallery. It is a brand statement. Every post, every caption, every reel either builds the brand or chips away at it. You know which is which before you publish.

This role is not for someone who needs direction on every decision. It is for someone who internalizes a brand deeply enough to make the right call independently, consistently, and without being reminded.



What You Will Do

For LEKKER Studios



Own the full creative direction and content strategy across all platforms

Maintain brand voice, visual consistency, and editorial standards in every post

Build and execute monthly content calendars aligned with business goals

Collaborate with the founder on campaign direction and key brand 
nts

Track performance and bring real strategic observations, not just numbers



For Our Clients



Manage 3 to 8 active client accounts at any given time

Build individual content strategies per client based on their brand identity and market position

Post daily across Instagram, TikTok, and
 with platform-appropriate content

Edit short-form video and reels from provided photo and video assets

Handle client approvals proactively. Nothing ships late. Nothing goes out wrong.





What Brand Fluency Means Here

You can look at a brand and know what it stands for before reading the bio.

You understand that a $3.5M listing in Alpine and a spec build in Ridgewood do not get the same energy, the same caption structure, or the same posting rhythm. You feel that difference without being briefed on it every time.

You know that consistency is trust. An inconsistent grid erodes brand equity quietly. You protect it.

You understand that your aesthetic does not override the client's identity. You serve the brand. Your job is to make them more themselves. Not more like whatever is trending this week.

You write captions that sound like a human being with taste and intention. Not like a prompt. Not like a template. Not like every other luxury real estate account in the tri-state area.

You know the difference between growing followers and building the right audience. You optimize for the second one.



What We Require



Demonstrated experience managing social media for multiple brands simultaneously

A portfolio that shows real creative range across different brand voices and markets

Real estate, architecture, design, or luxury lifestyle content experience strongly preferred

Strong short-form video editing skills. CapCut, Premiere, or equivalent.

Platform fluency on Instagram Reels, TikTok, and

Content scheduling experience with tools like Later, Buffer, or Planoly

Writing ability that holds up across brand voices without sounding generated

The ability to read analytics and turn them into strategic decisions, not just reports



You will be asked in the interview to analyze a brand cold and tell us what it communicates. This is not optional. It is the job.



How You Operate

You are proactive. You surface issues before they become problems. You bring ideas without being asked. You communicate clearly and briefly. You ask smart questions early and execute without hand-holding after that.

You are told something once.

You take ownership of your accounts the way a founder takes ownership of their business. Not because someone is watching. Because the standard matters to you personally.



Compensation

Competitive and commensurate with experience and portfolio quality. Growth in responsibility and compensation is real for people who perform.

To apply: DO NOT
 AS THIS IS A PRIVATE POST.  

Send your portfolio. Name three accounts you have managed in the past year and what you built there. Tell us in a few sentences why this role makes sense for where you are headed.

Deployment & Testing

Integrations & System Support

User Support & Training

mbers.

, WhatsApp, and SMS

title: Business Development Analyst
description:
GUIDESOURCE



Business Development Researcher – Buy-and-Build Origination (Remote, Full-Time)

About Guidesource



Guidesource is a UK-based deal origination firm. We help acquisitive, founder-led businesses grow through acquisition by finding off-market companies for them to buy before those companies reach advisers or the open market. We run a systematic origination function for clients who have the appetite to acquire but no in-house team to source deals.

We are growing our outbound engine and are hiring a full-time Business Development Researcher to power it.



The Role



This is a research and outreach role at the heart of our growth. You will build our pipeline of prospective clients: UK businesses that are actively acquiring and likely to keep acquiring. You will find them, research them, and run personalised
 outreach to open conversations. This is not a generic mass-mailing role. Quality of targeting and personalisation is what makes it work.



Day to day you will:



• Find acquisition-active UK SMEs using sources such as Companies House, the trade and business press, lender and funding announcements, and LinkedIn.

• Qualify each company against our target profile: founder-led or owner-managed, operating in a fragmented sector, with at least one acquisition in the last three years and signs they intend to do more.

• Enrich each target: identify the right decision-maker, find a verified
 and LinkedIn profile, and capture the specific event (an acquisition, a funding round, a stated plan, a key hire) that justifies the outreach.

• Write personalised first-touch
s in our house style: direct, founder-to-founder, specific, no fluff.

• Send and manage outreach from our company
 aliases, tracking replies and follow-ups.

• Keep our master tracker clean and accurate: log every company, contact, send, reply and status, with no duplicates.



What We Are Looking For



Essential:

• Excellent written English. Your
s must read naturally and professionally, not like a template. This is the single most important requirement.

• Strong research skills and genuine curiosity. You enjoy digging into companies and finding the detail others miss.

• Commercial common sense. You can look at a company and form a view on whether it fits our profile and why.

• Comfortable with high-volume, accurate work. You can run consistent outreach week after week without quality slipping.

• Self-managing and reliable. You hit targets, keep records clean, and communicate clearly about progress and blockers.

• Familiar with tools such as LinkedIn, Gmail, Google Sheets or Excel, and lead-research platforms (e.g. Apollo). Training will be given on our specific process.



Nice to have:



• Previous experience in B2B lead generation, sales development, recruitment research, or M&A / corporate research.

• An understanding of mergers, acquisitions, or private equity, or a strong willingness to learn it quickly.

• Experience writing or editing professional
s for a Western business audience.



What Success Looks Like



We measure this role on outcomes, not just activity. In the first three months you will build a steady, well-qualified pipeline and run consistent personalised outreach. Success is measured by the number of well-targeted companies researched, the quality of personalisation, and ultimately the replies and conversations your outreach generates.

Practicalities

• Location: Fully remote. You can be based anywhere, but you must have a reliable internet connection and a quiet place to work.

• Hours: Full-time. Some overlap with UK business hours is required for coordination.

• Reporting: You will work directly with the founders.

• Compensation: [Add your salary here] - strong bonus structure



How to Apply



Send a short note telling us why this role suits you, along with your CV.
