title: Inside Sales Specialist – Premium Home Cleaning (USA)
description:
About The Mop & Broom



We're The Mop & Broom, one of the fastest-growing premium home cleaning services in Fort Worth, TX. We run a high-standards, remote operation and we do everything at the highest level. We're growing fast — and to keep growing, we need someone who genuinely owns their pipeline and drives revenue like it's personal.



Before you read further: this role is for someone who has been closing deals consistently for years, not new to sales. 

2+ years at minimum. We are looking for the best of the best and we will compensate to match.

Someone who tracks their own numbers without being asked, and doesn't need hand-holding to figure out what to do next. If that's you, what's below will get your attention. 



Application instructions are at the bottom — follow them exactly.



Compensation



This is one of the best-compensated remote sales roles available for the right person.



Base salary — tied to your monthly results. These will be tied to your core KPI:

- Required performance: $1,400/month

- Target performance: $1,600/month

- Great performance: $1,800/month

- Elite performance: $2,000/month



Performance incentives — no cap (6-10k+ annually):

- $20 per biweekly-equivalent recurring client booked

- $10 per one-time booking

- Expected incentive earnings: $6,000–$10,000+ annually



Additional:

- Potential weekend check ins required

- 40 hours PTO per year

- Long-term growth — we do performance reviews every 6 months, we promote from within and raise compensation for elite performers



Who You Are (what we're looking for)



You've been closing deals consistently for 3+ years and your conversion rate reflects it — you track it because you want to, not because someone makes you. You pick up the phone without hesitation and handle price objections without caving. Your pipeline is never a mess because you're in it every day. When you get feedback, you apply it — you don't need to hear the same thing twice. You see problems before they're brought to you and you show up with solutions. You hold yourself to a standard most people would find uncomfortable.



You're comfortable being measured. You've worked in a CRM and kept it clean. You write well and communicate clearly. You want to work somewhere that actually rewards performance — not just shows up for it.



Availability: Monday–Friday, 8 AM–5 PM CST + Saturday afternoon check-in (paid).

CRM experience required. GoHighLevel (GHL) experience is a strong plus.



What You'll Do



- Own the full pipeline from inbound lead to booked, recurring client

- Respond to all leads (phone, SMS,
, website, Google,
, Yelp) in under 5 minutes

- Convert leads into booked clients at 40%+ and push for recurring service (target: 35%+ recurring rate)

- Manage the GHL CRM daily — follow up, nurture, and close without lag

- Handle objections confidently and close without discounting

- Execute promotions, re-engagement campaigns, and upsell opportunities

- Report KPIs every Tuesday without reminders, and collaborate with ops on client onboarding

- Saturday afternoon check-in (4 hrs, paid) for bookings and operational messages



- 



How to Apply



Follow these instructions exactly. Applications that don't follow will not be considered — this is your first test.



1. Change the subject line to: "I want to work for you, Cormac and [Co-Founder's Name]"

2. Write 2–3 sentences at the top about why you're a great fit — specific to this role, not generic.

3. Include a 200–500 word writing sample written by you (not AI-generated).

4. Answer all of the following:

   a. How many years of sales experience do you have, and what were you selling?

   b. What CRM(s) have you used? Describe your day-to-day pipeline management.

   c. What was your average conversion rate in your most recent role? Share actual numbers.

   d. Tell me about a time you closed a difficult deal — what made it hard and how did you close it?

   e. What makes you different from other applicants? Be specific.

   f. Voice note (60–90 seconds): A prospect says, "You're more expensive than another company — I need to think about it." Respond as if you're on the live call.

   g. Attach your resume.



This is a high-performance role. If you want to own something real and grow with a company that pays for results — we want to hear from you.



— Olyvia M.

General Manager, The Mop & Broom

title: High-Performance Executive Operator (Data & Operations)
description:
This is not a traditional Executive Assistant role.



We are looking for a high-performance operator who can combine data intelligence with operational execution and work directly alongside a fast-moving, visionary leader.



This role is for someone who can bring structure to data, clarity to decisions, and execution to leadership initiatives.



If you thrive in fast environments, think analytically, and operate with ownership, keep reading.



Who We Are:



DAP Brands is a community of high performers building businesses that create real impact.



Our leadership team moves quickly, thinks strategically, and expects people to take responsibility rather than wait for instructions.



We value:

• Speed

• Accountability

• Emotional maturity

• Precision

• Ownership

• Loyalty to the mission (not ego)



What This Role Really Is:



This role combines Data Analysis + Executive Operations.



Your first responsibility is to bring order to data across the organization: Cleaning, structuring, and translating it into clear insights.



Once the data foundation is organized, you will operate as a high-level executive, helping leadership execute faster and smarter.



You will help:



• Clean, organize, and analyze business data

• Turn raw data into meaningful reports and insights

• Support leadership with decision-ready information

• Protect your leader’s time and priorities

• Enforce accountability across leadership initiatives

• Translate strategy into structured execution

• Identify problems before they become fires

• Move initiatives forward without constant direction

• Bring clarity to complex situations



You will sit close to leadership.

You will see how decisions are made.

You must handle that with professionalism, discretion, and maturity.



What This Role Is NOT



This role is not for someone who:



• Needs constant praise or reassurance

• Struggles with direct feedback

• Prefers slow corporate environments

• Gets overwhelmed by changing priorities

• Waits for instructions instead of solving problems

• Is uncomfortable working with data and systems

• Frequently job hops every year



We operate in a high-accountability environment.



If you need tone cushioning or excessive structure, this will likely feel uncomfortable.



What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days):



Within your first 90 days, you:



• Organize and clean key business data sets

• Create structured reporting for leadership decisions

• Build dashboards or reports that bring visibility to operations

• Run leadership meetings with clear structure and follow-through

• Anticipate your leader’s needs before they are spoken

• Track priorities and ensure accountability across teams

• Bring solutions instead of just raising issues

• Operate calmly and clearly under pressure



The Profile That Thrives Here



You likely:



• Have experience in data analysis, reporting, or business analytics

• Are comfortable working with spreadsheets, dashboards, and structured data

• Have supported a founder or senior executive before

• Have stayed 3+ years in at least one meaningful role

• Enjoy solving complex operational problems

• Can build systems and workflows from scratch

• Communicate clearly and directly

• Are emotionally regulated and professional under pressure

• Think in outcomes and insights, not just tasks



You are someone who:



• Notices patterns others miss

• Brings clarity where others see chaos

• Moves things forward without being asked twice



Compensation & Growth:



This role offers:



• Competitive compensation aligned with performance

• Direct exposure to executive decision-making

• The opportunity to shape internal systems and operations

• Long-term growth as the company scales



At DAP Brands, we reward impact and ownership, not just tenure.



Final Note



This role is for someone who wants to build, solve, and operate at a high level.



If you enjoy working with data, solving operational problems, and supporting leadership execution, this could be an excellent fit.



If you're looking for a comfortable, slow-paced corporate role, this probably isn't it.



But if you want to operate at a high level and help build something meaningful, apply on our website 
/careers and write MAVERICK before your name.

We’re hiring a Creative Generalist with strong design and video editing chops to produce compelling visual assets for our paid media campaigns, landing pages, and brand communication. This hybrid role supports 2–3 DTC brands to start and is perfect for someone who thrives on fast-paced creative production, balancing aesthetics with performance goals. You’ll be responsible for creating everything from static ads and animated social assets to UGC edits and conversion-driven landing page graphics.



Key Responsibilities:

• Design static, motion, and video ad creatives for Meta, TikTok, and Google

• Edit high-performing UGC ads with strong hooks, CTAs, captions, and transitions

• Repurpose testimonials, reviews, and influencer content for paid and organic use

• Create
, SMS, and promotional visuals aligned with brand identity

• Stylize social proof assets (e.g., screenshots, quotes) into branded, engaging formats

• Follow platform-specific best practices for ad creatives

• Ensure design supports performance goals like ROAS and CAC

• Maintain brand consistency across diverse formats and placements

• Collaborate with media buyers, marketers, and creatives to meet campaign goals

• Stay current with trends in ad design and DTC creative performance



Qualifications:

• At least 2 years of experience in graphic design and video editing for digital marketing.

• Advanced skills in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects).

• Proven experience creating high-converting static and motion ads for Meta, TikTok, or Google.

• Strong eye for layout, color, typography, and brand consistency.

• Experience editing UGC and social proof content for performance-driven campaigns.

• Able to follow creative briefs, meet tight deadlines, and collaborate well with remote teams.

• Portfolio demonstrating versatility across static design, motion, and video editing.





-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Creative Strategist will own the research, ideation, and optimization of creative assets across paid ads,
/SMS, landing pages, and UGC. They'll translate brand goals, market data, and consumer psychology into briefs, scripts, and testing roadmaps, partnering with designers, editors, media buyers, and UGC creators to execute.

• Ability to analyze creative performance metrics and translate data insights into actionable design or messaging improvements.

• Strong leadership and feedback skills to guide generalists and align creative output with performance goals.

title: IT Specialist & IT QA Specialist
description:
IT SPECIALIST



The IT Specialist is a strategic position that plays a pivotal role in the data integrity of key My Amazon Guy functions. The position is responsible for assisting the CTO and IT Department, maintaining and enhancing dashboards, data models, and data pipelines. Possess advanced analytical and decision-making skills. The role requires someone who is passionate about data quality, data analytics, and automation in order to drive business strategy. An ability to be an expert in problem-solving, critical thinking, and an understanding of complex system dependencies are essential in enabling the IT Manager to show where My Amazon Guy processes are broken and how those processes are affecting key data points. An individual with a strong passion to solve problems and improve data integrity will excel in this position.



Key Responsibilities:

• Manage and maintain company IT systems, ensuring optimal performance, reliability, and security across all platforms.

• Provide technical support and troubleshooting for software, and network-related issues across teams.

• Ensure implementation and compliance with security systems, including antivirus, firewalls, and two-factor authentication.

• Oversee and optimize the use of company tools (e.g., Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Asana, Slack, Monday, HubSpot, WordPress).

• Support website management and CMS platforms, ensuring functionality, updates, and performance optimization.

• Analyze system data and create reports, dashboards, and visualizations to support decision-making.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to understand workflows and improve system integrations and data architecture.

• Assist in automation and process improvements, including API integrations and workflow optimization where applicable.

• Document IT processes, provide training, and ensure teams are equipped to use systems efficiently.

• Proactively identify technical issues, recommend solutions, and implement improvements to enhance operational efficiency and quality output.



Qualifications:

• 1+ years of experience in an IT Help Desk role

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Ability to multitask and prioritize

• Experience with

• Data Analytics

• Jotform

• Airtable

• Zapier

• Hubspot

• Asana

• Google Workspace

• Database management is a plus but not required

• JavaScript, Python, CSS, HTML is a plus but not required

• Proficient with Microsoft Office, G Suite applications, and computer security systems

• Proficient with, or able to quickly become proficient with, a range of general and specialized applications, software, and hardware used in the organization and the industry.

title: QA Analyst : ERP & Business Systems URGENT

title: SEO & Website Growth Manager
description:
SEO & Website Growth Manager



Yum Street | Full-Time Remote | 40 Hours Per Week - Some looking for a long term job.



The 3 Key Skills We Need

SEO that generates enquiries, not just rankings

Website conversion and lead generation thinking

WordPress / website implementation ability



About Yum Street



Yum Street is a fast-growing catering and events business providing:



Corporate catering

Wedding catering

Private events

Festival catering

Mobile food units

Sporting venue catering

Venue partnerships



We are not looking for a basic SEO assistant.



We are looking for someone who can help turn our website into our number one salesperson.



Our goal is simple:



More enquiries. More quote requests. More bookings. More revenue.



- Not vanity traffic.

- Not keyword reports with no commercial impact.

- Not blogs for the sake of blogs.



The Role



We are hiring a full-time SEO & Website Growth Manager to take ownership of Yum Street’s organic growth.



You will be responsible for improving our visibility on Google, Google Business Profile, local search, AI search and our website but the real measure of success is whether your work creates more qualified enquiries.



This role is ideal for someone who understands SEO, but also thinks like a growth marketer.



You must be able to look at a website and ask:



“How do we turn more visitors into enquiries?”



What You Will Work On

SEO strategy

Local SEO

Google Business Profile optimisation

Website conversion improvements

Service landing pages

Location pages

Corporate catering pages

Wedding catering pages

Event catering pages

Technical SEO

Keyword research based on buyer intent

Website content strategy

Blog and resource strategy

Case studies

FAQs and AI search optimisation

Internal linking

Tracking enquiries, calls and quote requests

Monthly performance reporting

WordPress updates and implementation

What We Do NOT Want



Please do not apply if your only focus is:



Backlinks

Meta titles

Generic blog writing

Traffic with no enquiries

Ranking reports with no business outcome

AI-generated content with no personality

Technical SEO without commercial thinking



We need someone who understands that SEO is only valuable if it helps generate enquiries and bookings.



What Great Looks Like



The right person will understand how to create pages and systems around searches such as:



Wedding catering Southampton

Wedding catering Hampshire

Corporate catering Southampton

Corporate catering Hampshire

Event catering Hampshire

Food truck hire London

Street food catering for events

Mobile catering for corporate events



You should understand customer intent, landing pages, trust signals, calls to action, quote forms, reviews, case studies and the journey from Google search to enquiry.



Tools & Skills



Strong experience with some or all of the following is preferred:



WordPress

Google Search Console

Google Analytics / GA4

Google Business Profile

SEMrush / Ahrefs / SE Ranking

Screaming Frog

Looker Studio

Rank tracking tools

Local SEO tools

ChatGPT / AI search tools

Basic HTML / CSS

Conversion tracking

CRM or automation tools such as GoHighLevel

Working Hours



This is a full-time role.  40 hours per week



You must be available to work agreed UK working hours.  We use time tracking and daily reporting. This is non-negotiable.



Important Application Questions



To apply, please answer the following 5 questions carefully.



Applications that do not answer these questions properly will not be considered.



1. Yum Street currently receives website traffic but wants more enquiries.

If you joined us, what would you do in the first 30 days to generate more enquiries from the traffic we already have?

2. If our Corporate Catering page received 300 visitors per month but only generated 2 enquiries, what would you review and what specific changes would you make?

3. What are the first 10 high-intent keywords or page ideas you would focus on for Yum Street, and why?

4. Give one real example where your SEO or website work generated leads, enquiries, bookings or revenue. Please include numbers if possible.

5. What is the difference between an SEO Specialist and a Website Growth Manager?

What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who can:



Think commercially

Understand customer behaviour

Build landing pages that convert

Improve Google visibility

Improve Google Business Profile

Create useful content from real business experience

Track enquiries and conversions

Explain work clearly

Take ownership

Work directly with directors

Help Yum Street grow

Final Note



This is not a role for someone who only wants to complete SEO tasks.



This is a role for someone who wants to help build a serious inbound enquiry engine for a growing catering and events business.



If you think like a business owner, understand SEO, and know how to turn website visitors into real enquiries, we would like to hear from you.

title: Lead Generator / Business Development — Fil-Am Owned Creative Studio
description:
About Us

We own a brand strategy consultancy working with companies that want their brand to mean something: not just *look good*.



We specialize in helping mission-driven organizations, health and wellness companies, music and entertainment brands, and culturally-led businesses sharpen their positioning, messaging, and brand strategy. We work with founders and leadership teams who are building things they actually believe in... and we help them tell that story in ways that build trust, attract the right audience, and stand out in saturated markets.



We're growing, and we're looking for a sharp, well-connected lead generator to help us find the right kinds of clients.



The Role

This is a performance-based business development role: you earn a commission on every new client you successfully source and close for us. Your job is to find companies that should be working with us... and get them into the conversation. You'll build a pipeline of qualified leads, run initial outreach, set up calls, and help move conversations from "interested" to "signed."



Should you showcase grit, tenacity, and exceptional lead gen skills in your first 90 days, we can not only consider a fair monthly retainer rate (on top of performance pay) but also 



The Kind of Clients We Want

Not all clients are good clients. We're being deliberate about who we work with. The companies we want you to find sit in some combination of:

>> Mission-driven — they're building something that matters, not just chasing market share

>> Creatively ambitious — they care about doing things differently and aren't afraid of bold brand work

>> Health, wellness, mental health, or youth-focused — this is where our deepest expertise lives 

>> Music, entertainment, or cultural — labels, indie production companies, festivals, creator-led brands (we are just now making a name for ourselves in this space and want to continue growing here to work with larger, more mainstream brands and companies)

>> Mid-stage and growing — typically Series A to C, or established mid-market companies, with real budgets and real teams (but we are also open to working with several corporate clients to lock in larger retainer rates) 

>> Decision-makers with taste — founders, CEOs, CMOs who care about the craft, not just the deliverable



Companies we don't want:

>> Anything that exploits the audiences we care about (predatory health products, addictive tech aimed at youth, etc.)

>> Pure performance-marketing shops looking for cheap brand polish

>> Anyone who treats brand work as a checkbox rather than a strategic investment





What You'd Do

>> Research and identify companies that fit Rou's ideal client profile

>> Run outreach (LinkedIn is not our favorite TBH as we didn't see success in our last lead gen person who used it but still open to it,
, warm intros) and qualify leads

>> Schedule discovery calls with our Founder 

>> Help move qualified leads through the conversation pipeline (i.e sending follow-ups, sharing case studies, coordinating proposal timing)

>> Build and maintain a CRM / pipeline tracker that becomes a permanent operational asset

>> Bring your own network and instincts about which companies are ready for this kind of work





Compensation Structure

This is a performance-based business development role, meaning your earnings are tied directly to the new client revenue you bring in. We've built a commission structure that's competitive, fair, and rewards the kind of clients we actually want, with caps and timing rules that protect both sides for engagements of different sizes and shapes.



We're happy to walk through the specifics on a first conversation. The short version: meaningful upside on each signed client, with a structure that recognizes the difference between one-off projects, retainers, and larger contracts.



> For the right candidate, we're also open to discussing a small monthly retainer in addition to performance pay (note that if a hybrid structure would work better for you, tell us in your application)

> Payment: Commission is paid after the client has actually paid us (not at contract signing), via Wise, PayPal, or direct deposit.

> Eligible clients: New clients you sourced or actively helped close, who were not previously in Rou's active pipeline. A list of in-progress prospects will be shared at start.



Who You Are

>> Experienced in business development, sales, or lead generation — ideally for a creative agency, consultancy, or B2B services company

>> Naturally well-connected, with a network you actually use and can speak to with credibility

>> Strong on outreach: you know how to write a message that gets opened, get past gatekeepers, and turn cold contacts into conversations

>> Self-managed and self-motivated (performance-based pay only works for people who can actually run their own pipeline without micromanagement and is eager to move the needle)

>> Genuinely interested in the kinds of brands we want to work with (health, wellness, music, mission-driven, culturally-led) 

>> Comfortable with the realities of performance-based pay: real upside, real risk, longer sales cycles



Bonus if you have:

> Existing relationships at agencies, consultancies, or in-house brand teams at mid-stage companies

 > Background in health/wellness, music/entertainment, or nonprofit/social impact

> Experience selling strategy services (vs. selling production or media)

> Familiarity with how brand strategy work actually gets bought (who d
, when in their year they have budget, what triggers them to look for help)





What This Isn't

> Not a salaried sales role (unless we evolve into one together over time)

> Not a fit if you need predictable monthly income from this alone

> Not a fit for high-volume / spray-and-pray lead gen. We'd rather you bring 3 great leads a month than 30 bad ones

> Not a fit if you'd push us to take clients we don't want (the cap, the carve-out, and the client profile are all in place because client fit matters more than volume)





How to Apply

Send the following to us in response to this job posting and our team will evaluate: 

> A short summary of your business development experience, including industries you've sold into and rough deal sizes you've worked with

> A few sentences on what kinds of companies you'd be excited to bring to our agency, and why

> One example of an outreach message you've written that actually worked (the message, plus context on the result)



We read every application sent in this format and respond to everyone within two weeks.
